Rapper #LilBaby had a hilarious but understandable reaction when a fan asked him to sign his album cover using his real first name instead of his stage name “Baby.”

The fan explained that seeing the name “Baby” displayed on his wall every morning would feel a little strange, especially when he could simply have his actual name written instead.

While it might seem like a small request, Lil Baby made it clear that there’s a difference between his identity as an artist and who he is outside of music.

Was the fan outta pocket for this?
